ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution restricted to margins and isolated focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity pigmentation across 90%+ of the visible surface; high-contrast white clusters localized at the distal tips and three distinct, spatially separated circular rings on the lower-medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical plunge; estimated internal angle of 45 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) across the entire trailing edge boundary, with significant relief increases (10-20 pixels) at the distal tips due to encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Deeply concave trailing edge curve transitioning from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct clusters of roughly circular high-contrast rings (white perimeter, dark center) on the mid-right lobe and dense, high-relief clusters on both distal extremities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral biological encrustation (barnacle colonization) causing extreme topographic irregularities on the lateral margins; multiple circular white scars present on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated white 'check-mark' pigmentation feature located near the lower trailing edge of the right lobe.
